acceptance: Red first: a fixture cache with 44 GB allocated and 20.9 GB counted fails the cache row through the real `evolve gc review`; a fixture of many files under 4 KiB passes it
Red first: free disk under gc.disk_warn_gb fails the disk row; no FAIL row has action none
Red first: a FAIL row runs its apply once more and the record holds both readings
Red first: the run writes wave-<N>.json and one GC_REVIEW_* signal; the boundary chain runs the step once, after gc and before the launch
Red first: a FAIL verdict and an unreadable disk both reach the launch step with rc 0
Red first: a shadow-stage check with planned items gets SHADOW and does not fail the wave; a check without retry: true gets console-route; the wave number at boundary time is the wave that ends
Red first: a registered check with no review row fails the guard test
New code at 100% measured coverage of the changed functions; one end-to-end test through the real verb
fix: Add `evolve gc review [--wave N] [--json]`: scan each registered check with no apply; per check print reading, threshold of the check itself (its cap, TTL or disk level; gc.review.checks.<check> holds only the action, retry permission and tolerance), PASS, FAIL or SHADOW (a shadow-stage check reports its planned count and never fails the wave) and one action (none for PASS and SHADOW; retry-apply, file-item or console-route for FAIL). retry-apply is allowed only for a check with retry: true (cache, temp, processes) and runs the same stage-aware apply as `evolve gc` once more, reads the row again and records both readings (D28). Rows: the disk (free bytes of the .evolve volume and the temp dir, through a classifier extracted from diskSignal) and the cache size through one sizer allocatedBytes (st_blocks, hard link once, <hash>-d dirs included) that the trim counter also calls, with a second row comparing the sum over the entries the trim walks with allocatedBytes of the cache root, within gc.review.cache_counter_tolerance_pct. Record .evolve/gc-reviews/wave-<N>.json and append GC_REVIEW_PASS or GC_REVIEW_FAIL. Boundary step after gc and before the launch, advisory: true, exit 0 on any verdict and read error; wave number from the wave history (cmd_wave_compose.go:105), --wave overrides. A FAIL files at most one inbox item per check and wave. A registry guard test fails a check with no review row. `evolve wave checkin` and the console check-in SOP read the record. X13 writes the review rows of every check registered when it builds (X1a to X1e, the cache check, X11 and X12).
summary: Plan docs/plans/cycle-recycle-and-gc-check-2026-11.md section 13, decisions D27 to D30, component X13. In wave 186 free disk fell to 5 GiB (operator) and the disk guard paused cycle starts 20 times (grep -c HOST_DISK_LOW .evolve/signals.ndjson = 20). The Go build cache was 44 GB by du while evolve gc --only cache counted 20.9 GB against a 20 GB cap (operator). Today `evolve gc check` prints items with no reading, threshold or verdict, and `evolve wave checkin` does not exist (item wave-checkin-verb-runs-the-static-sop).
title: evolve gc review scans every check again at wave end and prints one recorded static verdict
